judgement.reason: Homebox supports PostgreSQL and a blob storage connection string that can target S3, so moving data off local disk is a settings or contained change.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /data (Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The production image stores uploaded files on local disk through a file:// storage connection string under /data, and it defaults to SQLite at /data/homebox.db, so /data holds durable state that the shown lines do not move to S3.
